implementation_summary: (1) Manifest as a file contract. Added src/a2ui/components.ts — the dependency-free declaration of SUPPORTED_COMPONENTS (18 Basic Catalog names); registry.tsx now re-exports it instead of deriving it from A2UI_COMPONENTS, and the pre-existing registry test ('derives SUPPORTED_COMPONENTS from the component registry') becomes the anti-drift guard between the list and the actual React implementations. manifest.ts imports './components' + './config' only, so the whole manifest graph is DOM-free. Added scripts/generate-a2ui-manifest.ts, run by the new npm script 'a2ui:manifest' via vite-node (already present in node_modules via vitest; no new dependency, no build step). It writes src/a2ui/a2ui-manifest.json = JSON.stringify(getManifest(), null, 2) + newline — the committed snapshot the backend contract test reads {catalogId, protocolVersion, components (sorted), compositionHash}. A direct vite-node run over the old manifest.ts was tried first and fails (registry.tsx pulls the whole design system: 'ReferenceError: window is not defined'), which is why the name list was split out; a jsdom shim was rejected as an endless-globals hack. Contract tests added in src/a2ui/__tests__/manifest.test.ts: the committed JSON must deep-equal getManifest() and must be byte-identical to the generator's serialization; both fail with the hint 'a2ui-manifest.json is out of date — run npm run a2ui:manifest' and never repair the file. Prettier check on the JSON passes, so lint-staged cannot reformat it out of sync. (2) Assistant form switched to the boolean. InteractiveFeaturesSection takes value: boolean and emits booleans (same single Switch 'Enable interactive features', unchanged UX); its InfoBox no longer enumerates the legacy element registry (catalogElementLabels) but describes the A2UI Basic Catalog with the component count read from SUPPORTED_COMPONENTS. InteractiveFeaturesAccordion binds the form field 'interactive_enabled' (feature-flag gate on 'interactiveElements' unchanged). AssistantForm yup schema: interactive_features object dropped, interactive_enabled: Yup.boolean().default(false); default value from assistant?.interactive_enabled ?? false. Types: Assistant and CreateAssistantDto gain interactive_enabled?: boolean; Assistant keeps interactive_features marked @deprecated (T-X2 removes it), CreateAssistantDto no longer declares it. transformAssistantToCreateDTO (src/store/utils/assistants.ts, the create+update payload mapper) sends interactive_enabled: assistant.interactive_enabled ?? false and stops sending interactive_features entirely. NOTE: the wire field is snake_case interactive_enabled (verified in the backend AssistantRequest/AssistantBase, no camelCase alias generator), not 'interactiveEnabled' as the task brief stated; form field names are the wire names in this form because prepareFormData spreads values into the request.
